- height: INTEGER

PRIMARY KEY (id)

arguments.sql:
SELECT p.player_api_id, pa.date, pa.crossing
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC, pa.date ASC
LIMIT 5
